title: Six distinct operator workflows
detail: Real published company work informs the catalogue. All owners, boats, moorings, permits, measurements, prices and decisions are explicitly invented demonstration data.

title: Complete seasonal service
detail: The first four jobs carry finalized findings, original evidence, required checks, gear storage and frozen completion snapshots. One linked repair is completed, visibly reopened and completed again.

title: Authority response and corrected handoff
detail: The first original submission is returned with a specific issue. Its separate amended successor is reviewed, sent and records a demonstration approval. The permit remains a separate original decision record.

title: Continue actual unfinished work
detail: The fifth job remains in progress; the sixth remains confirmed. A conflicting request and next-year permit mismatch show concrete review findings without changing those saved jobs.

title: Full original intake
detail: The BOM/CRLF CSV, quoted comma, row decisions, one new asset and one preserved existing-asset link travel in the full working export.
